_doc: Brain-controlled knobs. Each entry is a per-factor-bucket multiplier (1.0 = neutral). weight_applier.py mutates these per proposal, capped at 5%/week per factor. Kill floor is 0.5 (never 0.0) so killed buckets stay recoverable. Reset to neutral on 2026-10-29: every prior value came from a pytest fixture (rsi buckets) or the unverified May-2026 backtest; the loop relearns from live verified outcomes via calibration_propose -> weight_apply.
